data.name: Alqama
data.gender_notes: Alqama is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Alqama means strong, firm, or solid in Arabic. It is a name that signifies stability and resilience. The name Alqama carries the meaning “Strong, firm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Alqama usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Alqama is associated with a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and a renowned scholar of the early Islamic period.
data.etymology: Alqama belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, firm.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alqama total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ألقما
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي يعني الشخص القوي والشجاع
in_arabic.long_meaning: ألقما هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'ألقم' الذي يعني إلقام الشيء في الفم أو إعطاءه إياه. يرمز الاسم إلى الشخص القوي والشجاع الذي يلهم الآخرين بالشجاعة والإقدام. ورد ذكره في بعض المصادر العربية القديمة كاسم للشخصيات البارزة في العصور الوسطى، وغالبًا ما يرتبط بالخصال الحميدة مثل الشجاعة والكرم.

in_urdu.name: القما
in_urdu.meaning: القما کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور بہادر شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: القما ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے ایک مضبوط اور بہادر شخص جو دوسروں کو بھی সাহس اور جرأت کی الهام دیتا ہے۔ عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ، اس نام کا تعلق قدیم عربی ثقافت سے ہے جہاں بہادری اور مضبوطی کو بہت اہمیت دی جاتی تھی۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے، یہ نام تقوی، بہادری، اور اچھے اخلاق کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अलक़मा
in_hindi.meaning: अलक़मा का अर्थ है एक मजबूत और बहादुर व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलक़मा एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से आया है। यह एक मजबूत और बहादुर व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है जो दूसरों को साहस और 용ा की प्रेरणा देता है। अरबी मूल से निकला, इस नाम का संबंध प्राचीन अरबी संस्कृति से है जहां वीरता और शक्ति को बहुत महत्व दिया जाता था। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पवित्रता, वीरता, और अच्छे चरित्र का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: الاقا
in_pashto.meaning: الاقا د قوي او زړور سړي نوم دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: الاقا د مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی. دا د قوي او زړور سړي لپاره کارول کيږي چی نورو ته د زړورتیا او قوت الهام ورکوي. د عربي ريښو څخه مشتق شوی، دا نوم د پخواني عربي کلتور سره تړاو لري چي پکله زړورتیا او قوت ته ډير اهميت ورکول کیده. د افغان او پښتون دود، دا نوم د تقوی، زړورتیا، او ښايسته اخلاقو نښه ده.

in_english.name: Alqama
in_english.long_meaning: Alqama is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning a strong and courageous person. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'alqam', it signifies someone who inspires bravery and fortitude in others. Historically, the name has been associated with notable figures in medieval Arab societies, embodying virtues such as valor, generosity, and resilience. In Islamic tradition, Alqama symbolizes spiritual strength, moral integrity, and leadership qualities. Across Muslim cultures, the name Alqama continues to be appreciated for its rich historical significance and aspirational meaning.

data.cultural_impact: Alqama is a name that has been used throughout Islamic history among scholars, poets, and warriors. It carries a sense of strength and determination. The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is reported to have said, "Call him Al-Qasim, for thus was the name of my uncle, Al-Qasim ibn Al-As, and he was a man of dignity and strength in the tribe." (al-Bukhari and Muslim) This emphasis on character and fortitude can be seen in the many notable figures with the name Alqama, such as Alqama ibn Thabit, a renowned poet in Medina during the early Islamic period, and Alqama ibn Ja'far, a prominent leader in the early Abbasid Caliphate. Moreover, Alqama is associated with the Quranic verse "We have explained in this Quran every kind of knowledge and given judgments for all things" (16:89), which highlights the importance of knowledge and wisdom in one's life and the decisiveness that comes with it.
data.spiritual_significance: Alqama, as a name that signifies stability and firmness, can be seen as a reminder of the importance of having a strong faith and unwavering commitment to Allah (SWT). It encourages individuals to be rooted in their belief and to stand firm in the face of adversity. In addition, Alqama is linked to the Prophet Muhammad's uncle and the name of this verse in the Quran, enhancing the significance of seeking knowledge and wisdom in one's spiritual journey. The name Alqama serves as a encouragement to not only be strong and resilient in this world but also in our relationship with Allah, striving for righteousness and seeking His satisfaction in every aspect of our lives.
